    """Compute makespan for a given permutation using the flow-shop recurrence.
    pt: (n, m) array of processing times.
    perm: array of job indices in order.
    Returns makespan (scalar).

    n = len(perm)

    delay caused by j after i, which depends on the cumulative 
    processing times.
    
    We use a simplified model: C[i,j] = sum_m max(0, pt[j,m] - pt[i,m])

            # The penalty is how much j extends the bottleneck relative to i

            # Only positive differences matter (j is slower than i on that machine)
